 Northrop Grumman Introduces Raid Hunter™ for Next Generation Gun-Based Air Defense System
 New air defense system strengthens layered protection against cruise missiles, drone swarms and evolving aerial threats

 TRANSLATIONS

 FALLS CHURCH, Va. – Aug. 11, 2026 – Northrop Grumman (NYSE: NOC) is unveiling Raid Hunter™ : The official name for its innovative 50mm Gun - Based Air Defense System. Designed to close a critical gap in short-range layered defense, Raid Hunter provides scalable, resilient and cost-effective protection against increasingly complex aerial threats facing today's warfighters. As adversaries continue to expand the use of cruise missiles, drone swarms and other advanced aerial threats, Raid Hunter delivers rapid, high-capacity firepower to protect military bases, airfields and other critical infrastructure . 
 Highlights : 
 Raid Hunter combines proven C hain G un ® technology, precision‑guided 50mm ammunition and a networked, interoperable system controller to deliver powerful protection against high-volume, mixed -threat aerial raids. It is designed to defeat a range of aerial threats including high‑priority cruise missile threats , unmanned aerial systems (UAS), and other advanced threats. 
 Raid Hunter's guided 50mm ammunition combined with a high-rate-of-fire C hain G un ® delivers lethal, cost-considerate engagement with deep magazines and fast reloads, tackling the economic challenge of massed swarming threats. 
 Raid Hunter is built to deploy with speed and flexibility through a modular design for rapid transportation on the C-130, with future vehicle-mounted and container-based variants planned. 
 Raid Hunter is the latest product of Northrop Grumman's continued investment in advanced counter-UAS and air defense technologies designed to meet evolving operational requirements and emerging battlefield threats . 
 As part of the company's C-UAS integrated air and missile defense portfolio, the system supports layered defense architectures to protect critical assets across a range of operations. 
 Raid Hunter is Northrop Grumman's 50mm GBAD system, engineered to counter mass, mixed raids with rapid, precise firepower and modular deployment options. ( Credit: Northrop Grumman ) 
 Expert : 
 Kenn Todorov, vice president and general manager, command and control & weapons integration, Northrop Grumman: "Raid Hunter addresses a critical short-range defense gap by delivering rapid, high-capacity protection against complex, mass aerial threats like cruise missiles and drone swarms. It provides warfighters with a cost-effective, flexible tool to decisively defeat evolving threats now and in the future —strengthening the security of vital bases and infrastructure." 
 "War has evolved. Air Defenders need the ability to defend against large, complex raids designed to overwhelm traditional defense solutions. Raid Hunter addresses this critical need by delivering a cost effective and deep magazine solution which can be rapidly delivered to the warfighter at scale. Scalable from inception , it defeats evolving threats now and in the future – strengthening the security of vital bases and infrastructure." 
 Details : 
 Raid Hunter is optimized to defeat large quantities of aerial threats which would traditionally saturate defense , including cruise missiles, UAS and advanced threats. Its modular palletized form factor enables rapid , versatile deployment options and future vehicle-mounted and container-based configurations will expand operational use cases . 
 Northrop Grumman continues to collaborate closely with government and allied partners to mature Raid Hunter's capabilities. Planned testing throughout the year will further validate system performance and support accelerated fielding. 
 Raid Hunter is a key system in Northrop Grumman's portfolio of counter-UAS and air defense capabilities, known as Raid Defense Solutions. 
 Raid Defense Solutions is Northrop Grumman's advanced, scalable portfolio of layered kinetic capabilities designed to protect critical assets from increasingly complex and high‑volume aerial threats, including coordinated drone swarms. By integrating proven fielded programs, AI-enabled command and control, sensor fusion and high‑rate firepower this family of solutions will enable faster detection, smarter decision-making and coordinated engagements across a wide range of operational scenarios with future growth and adaptability opportunities. 
 Northrop Grumman is a leading global aerospace and defense technology company. Our pioneering solutions equip our customers with the capabilities they need to connect and protect the world and push the boundaries of human exploration across the universe. Driven by a shared purpose to solve our customers' toughest problems, our employees define possible every day.

 Summary
 Northrop Grumman introduced Raid Hunter™ as the official name for its new 50mm Gun-Based Air Defense (GBAD) system, a next-generation capability designed to strengthen short-range, layered air defense against increasingly complex aerial threats. Raid Hunter combines advanced battle management, proven Chain Gun® technology and precision-guided 50mm ammunition to help defend military bases, airfields and critical infrastructure from cruise missiles, drone swarms and other evolving threats while supporting the company's kinetic solutions portfolio, Raid Defense™ Solutions. 
 Key Takeaways
 Raid Hunter is engineered to address a critical short-range air defense gap by providing warfighters with a scalable, rapidly deployable capability to defeat cruise missiles, drone swarms and other complex aerial threats.
 As part of Northrop Grumman's Raid Defense™ Solutions portfolio, Raid Hunter™ reinforces the company's continued investment in counter-unmanned aerial systems (C-UAS) and integrated air and missile defense technologies that strengthen layered defense and protect critical military assets.

 Summary:
 Raid Hunter™ is Northrop Grumman’s scalable, networked short-range air defense system featuring guided 50mm ammunition and proven Bushmaster® Chain Gun®  technology, designed to defeat diverse high-volume aerial threats cost-effectively.
 Key Takeaways:
 Northrop Grumman’s Raid Hunter delivers affordable, adaptable gun-based defense against evolving, mass mixed aerial raids using precision-guided munitions and networked control.
 Raid Hunter’s platform-agnostic design and networked system controller enable rapid, flexible defense at operational tempo.
 Introducing Raid Hunter
 Formerly known as 50mm Gun-Based Air Defense (GBAD), Raid Hunter is redefining short-range air defense for today's operational tempo and tomorrow's toughest aerial threats. 
 The character of aerial attacks is changing. Adversaries are increasing the quantity, variety and capability of expendable airborne threats – cruise missiles, unmanned aerial systems (UAS), short-range ballistic missiles and coordinated swarm attacks – creating raid sizes that challenge conventional short-range defenses.
 Northrop Grumman’s Raid Hunter addresses this critical gap with a scalable, resilient gun-based terminal defense solution. Combining advanced battle management, proven Chain Gun® technology and precision-guided 50mm ammunition, Raid Hunter is optimized to defeat mass mixed raids, enhancing layered defense for bases, airfields and critical infrastructure.
 Take back the advantage with more intelligent fire.
 A first-of-its-kind steerable 50mm munition.
 Platform Agnostic
 Modular design supports palletized and future vehicle-mounted configuration
 Cost-Effective Intercepts
 Provides a cost-effective alternative to traditional missile interceptors
 Resilient Protection
 Protects critical assets, bases, infrastructure
 A networked, interoperable system controller based on Northrop Grumman’s cutting edge AiON C2 software
 Proven Bushmaster® Chain Gun® technology
 Precision-guided 50mm ammunition
 Raid Hunter disrupts the cost paradigm of engagement by providing a scalable, platform-agnostic terminal defense solution that lowers engagement costs while maintaining lethal effectiveness and increasing raid capacity.
 Enabling Technology
 At the core of Raid Hunter is the guided 50mm ammunition developed for Northrop Grumman’s Bushmaster® Chain Guns®. These munitions, launched in small salvos, execute multiple continuous inflight maneuvers to enhance lethality and overmatch on the battlefield—providing a lethal, cost-effective and resilient solution against a wide range of aerial threats.
 Adaptive, Flexible Deployment
 Raid Hunter’s modular design supports palletized and future vehicle-mounted configurations. Its C-130 transportability enables rapid repositioning and operational flexibility, ensuring the system can meet evolving mission demands in diverse theaters of operation.
